1
Masters of Action

Gym Lords know that not making a decision is a decision. They take immediate action on their goals. They know that an imperfect plan executed today is better than a perfect plan executed next week.

2
The Hero of Their Own Story

No one is coming to save them and they know that their fate is in their own hands. They take complete ownership in defining their values, recognizing their weaknesses and overcoming obstacles.

3
Dedicated to Serving Their Community

At their core they are in this business to change lives, help people, and be masters of transformation. The success of their clients is their success as well.

4
Lifelong Learners

There is no room for ego in the journey of a Gym Lord. In order to remain on top of industry trends and best practices, Gym Lords are constantly growing, accepting feedback, and trust in their coaches, just as their clients trust in them.

Tough conversations are second nature for Gym Lords. They say what needs to be said and they don't sugarcoat it. They know that keeping valuable feedback to themselves hurts everyone.

I've been a personal trainer for the last six years, running my business out of my parents' garage. This year I decided it was time to take things to the next level and help people change their lives on a much bigger scale. I know the value of good coaching, so I went looking for the best in the industry. That led me to Gym Launch, and I joined in July. In the three months since, I've doubled my business. That's a direct result of the expertise, knowledge, and guidance of the coaches here. To be clear, this is a coaching program, not a magic button. You have to put in the work to get the results. But the coaches are experienced, genuinely care, and want to see you win. The biggest value for me has been the people. Being surrounded by successful, ambitious gym owners changes how you think and how you operate. When you're in a room full of high achievers, your odds of becoming one go way up. A special thank you to the coaches who've made a real difference for me: Coach Rod, for pushing me out of my comfort zone every day in sales training. Coach Matt, my one-on-one coach, for truly understanding me, my business, and what it needs. Coach R.E., for teaching me sales strategies that put the customer first and are built around actually helping people. Coach Blake, for his energy, enthusiasm, and willingness to help anytime. Coach Ryan, for believing in me and sharing his own story of where he started and how he got to where he is. That conversation stuck with me. As I get ready to open my new gym, I feel more prepared than ever. I would be lost without them. If you show up, put in the time, and don't make excuses, this program will work for you.
